sloka: प्रियमाख्यामि ते देव शोकं त्यज सुदारुणम् ।अस्मिन् मुहूर्ते भ्रात्रा त्वं रामेण सह सङ्गतः ।। ६.१२८.३७ ।।
transliteration: priyamākhyāmi te deva śokaṁ tyaja sudāruṇam ।asmin muhūrte bhrātrā tvaṁ rāmeṇa saha saṅgataḥ ।। 6.128.37 ।।

translations.english: "That Kakuthsa for whom you are worrying and living as he was at Dandaka forest with bark tree fabric, and matted hair sent me to tell you about his welfare."
translations.hindi: इति द्वाबिशस्युत्तरशततमः सगः || १ न समाधेया--नोपदेष्टव्या CO 6: ८ CC-0.
